issue.title: Today 🍅 never attaches to task definitions in real-Obsidian Reading view
issue.description:
## Bug

Proposed by bob-cli-q5.5.1.6 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP); triaged and independently
reproduced by the bob-cli-q5.5.1 land agent.

In real Obsidian Reading view, a task definition that is linked under one of today's
open Pomodoros never shows its Today 🍅. Live Preview of the same note shows it.

Evidence from `scripts/obsidian-snooze-marks-e2e.cjs` (bob-plugins, isolated scratch
vault under xvfb + CDP):

- `reading-tomato-stamps`: the active Reading leaf has 7 `li[data-bob-today-key]` rows
  stamped. The only `.bob-today-mark` hosts are 3 invisible ones with no `li` ancestor,
  which are the hidden Live Preview widgets.
- `reading-tomato-regression`: 0 visible Reading tomatoes for the `sz-plain` Today
  row, even after reopening the note with warm caches.
- `lp-tomato-regression` passes (3 Live Preview tomatoes).

It reproduces on the **pre-snooze-display bundle** at bob-plugins `feaa5b42` (land-agent
run, report `file:explicit:9c81ddbaa8df1a6b70768210`) as well as at `73d028e5`/`a4bd99f2`.
The snooze display epic (bob-cli-q5.5.1) did not cause it. The Today Reading fragments
were last changed 2026-10-19 (bob-cli-9r, `035296a2`/`ef1a63c2`).

Root cause not localized. Rows get stamped, so source mapping reaches
`todayMarkStampRow`; the mark is then never inserted. Suspects in
`src/276-plugin-today-marks-reading.js`: `todayMarkDesiredForRow` returning null
(`isTodayCacheReady`, `todayMarkRenderedStatus`/`todayMarkStatusIsOpen`, or empty
`todayDetailsForKey` at postprocess time) with no later refresh repainting stamped rows,
or `todayMarkApplyToRow`/`todayMarkInsertAnchor` failing on real Reading DOM. The unit
suite `scripts/test-ledger-tools-today-marks-reading.cjs` passes on mocked DOM, so it
does not cover this. `docs/today-marks.md` "Live verification" already says to file a
follow-up rather than add title matching if Reading view shows no marks.

task_type_fields.impact: Reading view (and any rendered surface using the 276 postprocessor) never shows which tasks are on Today, so the Today marks contract's Reading-view promise is unmet; Live Preview is unaffected.
task_type_fields.repro: In bob-plugins: TMPDIR=<non-full dir> xvfb-run -a node scripts/obsidian-snooze-marks-e2e.cjs --out <dir> --report <file>; check reading-tomato-stamps (7 stamped li[data-bob-today-key], no visible .bob-today-mark under an li) and reading-tomato-regression (tomatoes=0). Same result on feaa5b42 with the current e2e scripts copied in.

issue.creation_reason: The snooze display visual-proof e2e found Reading-view Today tomatoes missing. The land agent reproduced it on the pre-epic bundle, so it is a standalone Today-marks defect with no active owner.
